plan.strategySummary: Short-term momentum and news-driven strategy focusing on liquid mega-cap technology and EV equities (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, TSLA) with clear trend confirmation.
monitoring: Track daily volume surges relative to 30-day average volume.
Monitor real-time financial news for catalyst events, earnings reports, or regulatory updates affecting AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, and TSLA.
Observe intraday moving average crossovers (e.g., 9 EMA crossing above 21 EMA on 15-minute charts) for trend confirmation.
entryConditions: Price breaks above key intraday resistance accompanied by above-average volume.
Positive catalyst or news headline with sustained buying pressure over a 30-minute window.
RSI between 50 and 70, indicating strong momentum without immediate overbought exhaustion.
exitConditions: Trailing stop-loss hit at 2% below entry or recent swing low.
Take-profit reached at a conservative 4% gain from entry.
Reversal in momentum indicators (e.g., MACD bearish crossover or breakdown below short-term support).

budgetGuidance.notes: Allocate a maximum of $500 per trade across a maximum of 3 concurrent positions to maintain diversification. Keep at least 25% ($500) in reserve cash to manage volatility and add to winning setups.

candidateTrades.rationale: High liquidity and stable trend characteristics; attractive for momentum plays upon breaking recent intraday highs.
entryTriggers: Breakout above morning high with volume > 1.5x average.
Positive product or supply chain news confirmation.

candidateTrades.rationale: Strong institutional backing and news sensitivity regarding enterprise AI developments.
entryTriggers: Hold above VWAP with rising 15-minute moving averages.

candidateTrades.rationale: Exceptional short-term volatility and heavy retail/institutional momentum driven by semiconductor and AI news.
entryTriggers: High relative volume in the first hour of trading.

candidateTrades.rationale: High beta asset ideal for rapid momentum swings and reaction to breaking macro or company headlines.
entryTriggers: Clear directional trend established in the first 30 minutes of the session.
News catalyst involving delivery numbers or regulatory updates.

conditions: Broad market indices (S&P 500 / Nasdaq) exhibit high chop with conflicting directionals.
Lack of clear trend confirmation or volume support across all candidate symbols.
Conflicting high-impact news that creates unpredictable whipsaws.
noTradeDecision.action: Remain in cash, hold positions on the watchlist, and wait for clear volume breakouts before executing any paper trades.

riskNotes: Strictly adhere to stop-losses to protect the $2000 total capital base from outsized drawdowns.
Avoid chasing parabolic moves without consolidation or volume validation.
This is a simulated paper-trading plan for educational purposes only.
assumptions: Execution will occur during standard market hours (9:30 AM - 4:00 PM EST).
Brokerage execution slippage and commissions are negligible for the purpose of this simulation.
Real-time news feeds and level 1/2 quotes are accessible for trigger validation.
